title: Doors of Silence - the prologue
description:
The Dark Secret of Pennsylvania (1988)

Step into a distorted, surreal, and oppressive reality. In 1988, a secret medical research center in rural Pennsylvania hidden from the world received patients affected by the Chernobyl disaster. Something went terribly wrong. Explore desolate corridors and abandoned laboratories to uncover a shocking truth suspended between biological experimentation and pure madness.

Survival Horror Built Exclusively for VR

• Navigate and freely interact within the pitch-black depths of the medical facility.

• Weaponize your flashlight's specialized ultraviolet mode. It's not just a tool to cut through the pitch-black darkness, but your primary defense to repel specific creatures.

Resource Management & Lethal Encounters

• You are neither safe nor alone in this facility. Survival demands tactical thinking and quick reflexes under pressure:

• Ammo and flashlight batteries are severely limited. Every resource spent could be your last.

• Solve challenging, physical puzzles embedded within the facility to unlock new areas and escape the living nightmare.

description_short: Built exclusively for VR. In 1988, a secret medical facility in Pennsylvania received patients from the Chernobyl disaster. Armed with scarce resources, fight terrifying creatures, solve puzzles, and escape a surreal nightmare born from a dark reality.
